title: Set up payroll
summary: Set up a payroll provider to run payroll, file employment taxes, and administer benefits.

parts.title: Compare payroll providers
parts.guidance: Compare payroll providers using the actual entities, worker locations, pay types, benefits and accounting requirements. Ask them to walk through relevant setup, reporting, corrections and support, including work they leave to the employer. Compare complete costs and implementation needs with finance and the people lead. Identify registration or migration gaps before selecting the provider.

execution.rationale: Finance and the people lead attend remote provider walkthroughs, test representative payroll tasks and discuss requirements before selecting the service.

parts.title: Sign up and configure payroll online
parts.guidance: Choose the setup route from the employing entity and employee work locations. Gather verified company details, existing registrations, funding information and workforce inputs before configuring the provider. Resolve pay schedules, tax responsibilities and payroll access with the responsible team, then review a first-run setup. Keep US and country-specific employment routes distinct; the same account checklist cannot establish every jurisdiction’s requirements.

options.title: Default — Sign up and configure payroll online
options.summary: Configure US payroll from verified employer details, relevant tax accounts, pay schedule, funding method and administrator roles. Reconcile employee work locations and pay types with the payroll specialist. Finance authorizes the funding connection, then payroll reviews the first-run preview and outstanding setup issues. Assign responsibility for returns, payments and corrections from the provider’s actual service scope and the employer’s remaining duties.

verify.how: A preview payroll run computes net pay and withholdings for every employee, and the provider shows the federal and state tax accounts connected.

execution.rationale: Gusto documents company/payroll setup and pay schedules; funding authorization and required employer signatures stay with their owners.

options.title: EOR - employees outside the US
options.summary: Use this route after selecting the country-specific employment arrangement and identifying the EOR as legal employer. Reconcile contract terms, payroll inputs, funding dates and benefits duties with the provider. Finance sets up authorized funding while the people team resolves employee onboarding. Check the first pay and exceptions with the EOR, keeping the company’s remaining responsibilities clear.
options.when: Employees outside the US and no local entities - an employer of record runs compliant local payroll

execution.rationale: Deel documents EOR contract and onboarding status, country-specific benefit information, invoice breakdowns and payment tracking in its web application. Compare these records for the first payroll and raise exceptions with Deel. Finance retains funding authorization, employees complete personal onboarding, and local advisers settle employment responsibilities; this evidence covers the stated Deel route.

options.title: UK - PAYE + RTI payroll
options.summary: Set up the applicable HMRC registration and UK payroll software using verified employer references and employee information. Assign responsibility for calculations, FPS reports, payments and corrections, and review pension duties separately. Use the nested steps to complete registration, check configuration and handle the first submission. Keep reporting, employee payment and amounts due to HMRC distinct in the first-pay plan.

parts.title: Register as an employer with HMRC (PAYE)
parts.guidance: Gather HMRC’s requested employer details and first-payday plan, checking for an existing registration. The authorized company representative submits the reviewed application. Pass the confirmed PAYE and Accounts Office references securely to payroll when they arrive. If payday comes before the reference, follow HMRC’s documented handling process and keep the outstanding submission with the payroll owner.

execution.rationale: HMRC documents the employer-registration application; the representative retains approval of the reviewed facts.

parts.title: Configure a UK-capable payroll provider
parts.guidance: Configure the UK payroll software with verified employer references, starter information, pay schedule and agreed pay components. Assign calculation review, report submission and error correction to the appropriate people. Check the reporting setup using the provider’s supported process and review the first payroll preview. Resolve configuration differences before they become an incorrect payment or HMRC report.

references.title: HMRC: Reporting payroll with an FPS

execution.rationale: Payroll staff enter the employer references and pay components in the selected UK payroll service and check the first preview before approval.

parts.title: File the first RTI submission on or before payday
parts.guidance: Compare the first Full Payment Submission with the approved payroll: employees, payments, deductions and pay date. The payroll owner authorizes transmission, ordinarily on or before payday under HMRC guidance. Check the acknowledgement and correct any rejection or inaccurate report. Track this separately from paying employees and settling amounts due to HMRC.

references.title: HMRC: Reporting payroll with an FPS

execution.rationale: The authorized payroll filer submits the FPS through the payroll service, checks acceptance and corrects rejected records; the deadline and payroll approval remain controlling.

references.title: HMRC: Reporting payroll with an FPS

execution.rationale: Payroll staff configure the UK employer and employee records in the payroll service, submit RTI and reconcile acknowledgements and corrections.

options.title: India - EPF/ESI employer setup
options.summary: Give the local payroll specialist the entity, establishments, workforce and compensation structure. Determine applicable EPF, ESI, tax and state requirements from current rules, then prepare the required registrations for the employer’s authorized submission. Reconcile issued identifiers and employee setup before the first payroll. Resolve current Labour Code, tax-transition and threshold questions for the actual employer.
options.when: Running payroll for employees in India

references.title: India Ministry of Labour: Labour Codes
Income Tax Department: TDS Compliance FAQs

execution.rationale: The employer representative completes the applicable EPF and ESI account setup through the official services, retaining personal identity and signatory actions.

options.title: Germany - Betriebsnummer + social insurance
options.summary: Ask the local payroll adviser which employer identifiers, social-insurance and tax setup the workforce needs. Prepare the Betriebsnummer application using verified entity details and required supporting identifiers, then obtain the employer representative’s authorization to submit. Connect the issued number to payroll and reporting responsibilities. Follow up on any remaining registrations before relying on the setup for the first run.
options.when: Running payroll for employees in Germany

execution.rationale: Payroll staff complete employer-number registration and configure downstream social-insurance reporting through the applicable digital services.

options.title: France - DPAE + DSN payroll
options.summary: Have local payroll determine the applicable pre-employment declaration and reporting setup. Prepare the DPAE from verified employee and start details and submit with employer authorization through the confirmed process. Configure the payroll information needed for DSN and assign routine and event-report responsibilities. Resolve rejected or incomplete filings and outstanding setup before treating administrative onboarding as complete.
options.when: Running payroll for employees in France

execution.rationale: The employer and payroll operator complete DPAE and DSN setup, submissions and corrections through the applicable official and payroll interfaces.

parts.title: Connect payroll to the books
parts.guidance: Map payroll categories to the ledger’s wage, employer-cost, deduction, liability and cash accounts, including department allocations where used. Check integration permissions with the account owners, then compare the first export or journal with the payroll preview. Work through rounding, duplicate postings, reversals and corrections with accounting. The mapping is ready when both systems reconcile and the team knows how to handle adjustments.

execution.rationale: Gusto's QuickBooks connection exposes account mapping and journal synchronization for payroll reconciliation and corrections.

parts.title: Register as a California employer with EDD e-Services
parts.guidance: If the payroll specialist determines California registration is required, gather EDD’s requested entity and employment facts and check for an existing account. The authorized representative enrolls or registers through e-Services for Business using the reviewed information. Distinguish portal access from an issued payroll-tax account, and pass confirmed identifiers to payroll. Follow up on pending registration and separately assigned returns or payments.

references.title: California EDD: Enroll in e-Services for Business

execution.rationale: EDD documents employer enrollment and registration through e-Services for Business.

parts.title: Register for payroll tax in each state where employees work
parts.guidance: Give the payroll tax specialist the employee work and residence locations, employing entities and planned moves. Determine applicable state and local accounts, checking existing registrations before preparing new applications. Obtain authorization for each required filing, then connect issued identifiers to payroll and reporting responsibilities. Reassess when work locations change; reciprocity and other location-specific facts may affect the setup.

execution.rationale: The payroll owner and adviser coordinate the required state and local registrations digitally, checking existing accounts and obtaining filing authorization for each location.

parts.title: Register as a New York employer (NYS-100)
parts.guidance: New York employers register once for unemployment insurance, withholding, and wage reporting by filing the NYS-100 through New York Business Express; the Department of Labor runs the UI account and the Tax Department the withholding account from the same registration. Pass the issued identifiers to payroll, which then files the quarterly NYS-45 combined return. Report each new hire to the Tax Department within 20 days of the hiring date.

execution.rationale: New York Business Express supports NYS-100 employer registration; Tax Department web services cover the referenced quarterly return and new-hire reporting. The employer confirms the entity, employee data and filing authority.

parts.title: Register for Texas unemployment tax with TWC
parts.guidance: The Texas Unemployment Compensation Act requires employers to register with the Texas Workforce Commission within 10 days of becoming liable (law rule us-tx.unemployment-tax-registration), using the free online Unemployment Tax Registration service. Texas has no state individual income tax, so there is no state wage-withholding registration — the TWC account and quarterly wage reports are the Texas payroll obligations. Pass the issued TWC account number to payroll.

execution.rationale: TWC documents browser registration with saved progress, employer-liability determination, account-number issuance and subsequent wage reporting. The employer supplies authorized ownership data; the public page presented an anti-bot challenge during review.

parts.title: Register as a Washington employer via the business license application
parts.guidance: Washington employer accounts open through the state business license application: hiring (or planning to hire within 90 days) requires the application, which establishes the Employment Security Department unemployment account alongside the Department of Revenue registration. Washington has no state income-tax withholding; payroll instead handles ESD quarterly reports and the state premium programs the ESD employer pages describe. Pass the issued account identifiers to payroll.

references.title: WA DOR — apply for a business license

execution.rationale: My DOR documents the employer business-license application, ownership and hiring details, submission and confirmation; ESD documents the linked employer account and quarterly-reporting service. SAW authentication remains with the authorized account holder; direct help retrieval returned 403, so the documented procedure was reviewed through the official indexed page.

parts.title: Register for Florida reemployment tax (DR-1) and file the quarterly RT-6
parts.guidance: Florida employers register for reemployment tax with the Department of Revenue through the Florida Business Tax Application (Form DR-1), online or on paper, once the law's liability conditions are met. Florida has no state individual income tax, so there is no state wage-withholding registration — the reemployment account and the Employer's Quarterly Report (Form RT-6) are the Florida payroll obligations. Pass the issued account details to payroll and confirm the first RT-6 cycle.

execution.rationale: Florida DOR links the online business-tax registration application and reemployment e-filing service for RT-6 reporting and payment. The authorized employer confirms liability, account data and the first reporting period before submission.

metadata.supportReason: Provider onboarding is a guided online form (needs EIN and bank account); the journal sync runs on the payroll API.

geoNotes.summary: Employer setup spans EPF (provident fund) and ESI (state insurance) registration plus state-level professional tax; salary TDS is deposited monthly against the company's TAN.

Register as an employer with HMRC for PAYE before the first payday, then report pay through Real Time Information (RTI) — a submission to HMRC on or before every payment — plus pension auto-enrolment duties.
You need a Betriebsnummer (company number) from the Federal Employment Agency before running payroll, then monthly social-insurance reports to each employee's health insurer and wage tax via ELSTER.
Every hire starts with a DPAE filed with URSSAF before the employee starts; monthly payroll then flows through the DSN (déclaration sociale nominative), France's unified RTI-style payroll report.

Register as an employer with Segurança Social and report each hire before they start (comunicação de admissão), then file the monthly remuneration declaration and withhold income tax through the Portal das Finanças.

Open a payroll (RP) program account on the CRA business number before the first remittance, withhold income tax, CPP and EI each pay run, and register with the provincial workers'-compensation board where your employees are.

Register as an employer with Inland Revenue as soon as you start employing staff (in myIR, or the paper IR334), then run PAYE: deduct tax and KiwiSaver each payday and file employment information with Inland Revenue.
geoNotes.actionLabel: Register as an employer — Inland Revenue

geoNotes.summary: No PAYE: resident employees' income tax is not withheld from salary — the monthly ritual is CPF (due at month end, enforcement from the 14th of the following month) plus annual IR8A/Auto-Inclusion earnings reporting, and IR21 clearance when a foreign employee leaves.
geoNotes.actionLabel: CPF — apply for a Submission Number

geoNotes.summary: Register for PAYG withholding by the day you first withhold (law rule au.payg-withholding-registration), then report each pay event to the ATO through Single Touch Payroll-enabled software and pay superannuation within 7 business days of payday.
